title: Initial launch
changes: Localization engine: projects, locales with fallback chains, namespaces with gated review policy, immutable content-hashed releases with key-level diffs.
Three-pane review workbench with placeholder chips, translation-memory suggestions, glossary hits, and a review queue.
Agent first pass on the Catentio runtime, behind a mechanical placeholder-safety gate on every write.
@forjio/locavello-cli: init, extract, pull, status, check, and pseudo — committed catalogs, generated typed keys (locavello.d.ts), and a CI gate.
@forjio/locavello-next: useT/getT/Provider with ICU MessageFormat and per-locale fallbacks — zero runtime dependency on Locavello.
Website mode: instant no-signup preview from the homepage, site crawl with per-page status, and a fail-open serving snippet with a locale switcher.
